name: wootty
description: WooTTY: modern web terminal with resilient PTY sessions

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @icoretech/wootty-web build && cd apps/server && go build ./...
scripts.ci: pnpm lint:ci && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.lint: biome check --write --assist-enabled=true . && pnpm lint:go && pnpm verify:governance && pnpm verify:go-toolchain && pnpm verify:terminal-contracts && pnpm lint:react && pnpm typecheck
scripts.lint:ci: pnpm biome:ci && pnpm lint:go:ci && pnpm verify:governance && pnpm verify:go-toolchain && pnpm verify:terminal-contracts && pnpm lint:react && pnpm typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm test:scripts && pnpm --filter @icoretech/wootty-web test && cd apps/server && go test ./...
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @icoretech/wootty-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @icoretech/wootty-web typecheck:contracts && pnpm --filter @icoretech/wootty-web typecheck:config
